text:
laura: morning check-in: did a pass on the python quickstart README, fixed the env var table and added a note about CUDA drivers. pushed a tiny sample app fix to the repo.

rishi: saw the README changes, nice. quick q — did you bump the SDK version in the sample requirements? CI was failing last night because of that.

laura: not yet, planning to bump to 0.9.3 today. kept the change minimal, just docs + sample app import fix.

dan: blocker: sampleapp container fails on mac m1 with the current Dockerfile. I left a comment in the PR with a workaround (use --platform linux/amd64) but we should decide long-term.

jess: re: Dockerfile — can we add a small note in the quickstart instead of changing default to amd64? most devs on mac prefer local dev flow. maybe add an "if on M1" callout.

laura: yep will add a mac section. also adding a tiny script to run the sample with qemu for local testing.

rishi: pinging @jess — can you review the sample app change? it's a one-liner in main.py (swap old import), tests are green locally for me.

jess: i can do a quick review after standup, should be <10m.

devex-bot: CI update: sample-app-tests — passed (run #122) :tada: https://ci.internal/redwood/122

dan: awesome, thanks bot. one more ask — can we add a tiny snippet in the SDK quickstart showing how to enable prefix caching? a 3-line example would help new users understand perf tradeoffs.

laura: good call. i'll add a small code block under "performance tips":
```python
from redwood_sdk import Client
client = Client(batch_policy="auto", prefix_cache=True)
```

laura: thanks team — today i'll: bump SDK version in sample, add M1 note + run script, add prefix-cache snippet, and merge once jess approves. blockers: none aside from jess review and confirming the version number.

jess: should be quick, i'll review in ~30m. :ok_hand:

rishi: FYI i'll follow up later with a short doc about quantization recommendations for the sample workloads (small draft). not blocking you.

laura: perfect, ping me when it's up and i'll link it in the quickstart.

dan: thanks — logging that as a follow-up in the sample-app issue.

laura: wrap: merging target EOD. any objections?

jess: none from me.

rishi: go for it.

devex-bot: Reminder: weekly docs sync at 16:00 today in #devex — agenda includes quickstarts and sample stability. :spiral_calendar:
